facts.answer: William J. Sandbrook, age 67, has served as a Director of the Company since April 2018. He has served as Executive Chairman and Chairman of the Board of Andretti Acquisition Corp. II since September 2024, and served as Chairman and Co-CEO of Andretti Acquisition Corp. from January 2022 until April 2024. From August 2011 until his retirement in April 2020, he served as President and Chief Executive Officer of U.S. Concrete, Inc., and as Chairman of the Board from May 2018 until April 2020. He was CEO of Oldcastle Inc.'s Products and Distribution Group from June 2008 to August 2011, CEO of Oldcastle Architectural Product's group from 2006 to June 2008, President of Oldcastle Materials West Division from 2003 to 2006, and President and CEO of Tilcon New York from 1995 to 2002. He is a registered Professional Engineer and holds an MBA from Wharton.
